scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && uv sync --project python && (cp -n server/.env.example server/.env || true)
scripts.dev: npm --prefix server run dev & npm run py:dev & npm --prefix web run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.py:dev: uv run --project python uvicorn app:app --app-dir python --port 8788 --reload --reload-dir python
scripts.align:fetch: uv run --project python python -c "from keyframe_sinhala.align import fetch; print(fetch())"
